Mother Account

All consolidated project data is visible only to the Mother Account.
Mother Account: full visibility of consolidated balance, projects, received funds and expenses. Sub Accounts never receive this consolidated data.

Sub Accounts

Create separate access with project-level visibility.

Access Levels

Full AccessCan create and manage projects inside the Sub Account workspace. Mother Account data remains hidden.
Limited AccessCan create and manage only projects created/owned by that Sub Account.
View OnlyCan only view assigned projects. No project creation, editing, expense or balance-management actions.
Security boundary: Sub Accounts cannot view Mother Account consolidated balance, Mother Account project data, or edit Mother Account projects.
